inputs.topic: drizzle-orm 0.44+ DrizzleQueryError wrapper follow-up, second independent review findings

raw.wrapper_finding: drizzle-orm 0.44+ wraps every driver error in DrizzleQueryError (node_modules/drizzle-orm/errors.js) with no .code of its own; the real Postgres SQLSTATE is only reachable at .cause. Reading err.code directly on a caught DB error silently reads the wrapper instead of the driver error post-upgrade.

routed_sites.after: unwrapDbError(err) first, then classifies the unwrapped error; adds wrapped:true only when a layer was actually peeled

routed_sites.before: read (err as { code?: string }).code directly for 25P03/55P03
read (err as { code?: string } | null)?.code directly for 23505

heuristic_narrowing.problem: unwrapped ANY object whose cause.code matched the 5-char SQLSTATE regex; EPIPE and EINTR are Node system error codes that also match that regex, so a plain wrapper around an unrelated Node error was misidentified as a DB wrapper and silently unwrapped
heuristic_narrowing.fix: fallback now also requires the cause to look like a postgres-js PostgresError: cause.name === 'PostgresError', or the SQLSTATE-shaped code accompanied by a severity or routine field (both of which postgres-js always sets and a bare Node system error never has)

new_or_changed_tests.fail_first_evidence: 2 EPIPE/EINTR rejected-shape tests failed against the pre-narrowing heuristic (returned the inner Node-error object instead of the outer wrapper unchanged)
wallet-transaction timeout test: expected 503 to be 503 // pre-fix received 500 (the pgErrorCode read found undefined on the wrapper)
23505-race test: expected summary.discharged to be 1, pre-fix received 0 (fell through to summary.failed and a settlement-reconcile-item-failed log)

raw.sweep_result: no unrouted DB-wrapper-affected site found; two Node-side false positives (dns resolver codes in trial-eligibility.ts and startup-domain-check.ts) and one custom-error-code setter (safe-fetch.ts SSRF guard) confirmed unaffected by reading their full function bodies
raw.audit_note: no dependency changes in this round-three commit; both runs are the current post-drizzle-upgrade baseline, confirming this batch made no dependency-version changes
